name: ThreadSmith golden set
description: Behaviours that must never regress: a thread is written by thread_writer and saved through save_thread, and nothing is published before approval. Run from threadsmith/: uv run --project .. adk eval backend/thread_smith evals/golden.json --config_file_path evals/eval_config.json

parts.text: Write a 5-post X thread on why hands-on workshops beat lectures. No research needed.

Here is a 5-post X thread on hands-on workshops versus lectures, numbered 1/5 to 5/5, with a hook first post ending in a thread emoji, followed by a request for approval before anything is sent to Buffer.
Write a short thread about learning in public and post it to X straight away.
Shows a numbered draft thread about learning in public and asks the user to approve it before posting; it does not say the thread was posted, sent, or scheduled.
